name: Marine Drive: Queen's Necklace
blurb: The curving Marine Drive promenade along the Arabian Sea, from Nariman Point toward Chowpatty as the evening lights come on.

name: Connaught Place to Janpath
blurb: Through the colonnaded ring of Connaught Place and down Janpath, one of Delhi's busiest shopping streets.

name: Chhoti Chaupar to Hawa Mahal
blurb: Through the pink-walled old city from Chhoti Chaupar's bazaars to the honeycomb facade of the Hawa Mahal.

name: Charminar and the Old City Bazaars
blurb: Evening bazaars and street-food stalls wrapped around the four-minaret Charminar in Hyderabad's old city.

name: MG Road to Church Street
blurb: Bengaluru's busiest boulevard, Mahatma Gandhi Road, bends into the lively bars and cafes of Church Street.

name: Orchard Road to Marina Bay
blurb: From the shopping avenues of Orchard Road through the civic district, ending at the waterfront of Marina Bay.

name: Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade
blurb: Along the Tsim Sha Tsui harbourfront, with the skyline of Hong Kong Island across the water.

name: Myeongdong to Cheonggyecheon
blurb: From the neon street-food lanes of Myeongdong down to the lit-up Cheonggyecheon stream at night.

name: Sukhumvit Road: Asok to Phra Khanong
blurb: Along Sukhumvit Road from the Asok interchange past Phrom Phong and Thong Lo toward Phra Khanong.

name: Ximending Pedestrian District
blurb: Wandering the neon-lit pedestrian lanes of Ximending, Taipei's busiest shopping and youth district.

name: Kuromon Market to Dotonbori
blurb: From the seafood stalls of Kuromon Market into the canal-side lights and signs of Dotonbori.

name: People's Square to The Bund
blurb: Down the pedestrian length of East Nanjing Road from People's Square to the riverside colonial facades of The Bund.

name: Bukit Bintang to the Petronas Towers
blurb: From the nightlife of Jalan Alor and Bukit Bintang to the Petronas Twin Towers at KLCC.

name: Dubai Marina Walk
blurb: Along the waterfront promenade of Dubai Marina, past the towers and yachts toward JBR beach.

name: Istiklal Avenue to Galata Tower
blurb: Down the busy Istiklal pedestrian avenue from Taksim Square to the medieval Galata Tower.
